_methodology.actual_victim_definition: Eligible pages present in snapshot t but absent in snapshot t+1
_methodology.k: Number of observed departures in the next snapshot; each policy predicts the same number of victims
_methodology.frequency_definition: Number of previous snapshots in which a page appeared; not exact logical access frequency
_methodology.limitation: This is not a logical page-reference trace or a cache hit-rate simulation. Snapshot departures may reflect buffer changes between observations.
